answer_1.quote: Large language models (LLMs) have become pivotal in performing various language processing tasks, such as text generation, dialogue, and summarization.

answer_2.quote: The evaluation metrics used in this study included the gold RM score, as described in the previous sections, and an additional evaluation using GPT-4o to determine the win rate.

answer_3.quote: Additionally, in Section 5.5, we employed GPT-4o for evaluation as an alternative to human assessment, accessed via Azure OpenAI. The specific model used was "gpt-4o" with the version "2024-05-13".

answer_4.quote: We conducted a small-scale human evaluation to compare the outputs of fDPO and DPO. We evaluate the first 50 test samples from the helpful and harmless datasets generated in the experiment in Section 5.5. For each of these 100 samples (50 per dataset), two human annotators independently evaluated which response was preferable, resulting in 200 evaluations (100 evaluations per dataset).
